name: xpath-es
description: An XPath 1.0 engine in TypeScript: strict by default (the Recommendation), an upstream-compatible mode for existing consumers, work and time limits for hostile documents, and a differential and hostile-document test gate against upstream xpath 0.0.36.

scripts.lint: oxlint --type-aware --tsconfig tsconfig.json -c .oxlintrc.json src scripts test bench
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.test:self: CANDIDATE=xpath node test/fuzz.ts xmldom08 150 7 all && CANDIDATE=xpath node test/mutation.ts
scripts.test:differential: CANDIDATE=./src/index.ts node test/fuzz.ts xmldom08 300 11 all && CANDIDATE=./src/index.ts node test/mutation.ts && CANDIDATE=./src/index.ts node test/fuzz-expr.ts xmldom08 40 60 5
scripts.test:differential:fork: node test/fuzz.ts xmldom08 300 11 all && node test/mutation.ts
scripts.test:oracle: node test/strict-oracle.ts xmldom08 40 150 91 ns && node test/strict-oracle.ts xmldom09 30 150 92 ns
scripts.test:modes: node test/mode-agreement.ts 60 100 91 && node test/strict-axes-fuzz.ts 60 100 91 xmldom08 && node test/strict-axes-fuzz.ts 40 100 92 xmldom09
scripts.test:dist:types: node node_modules/typescript-7/bin/tsc -p test/dist/types/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript-7/bin/tsc -p test/dist/types/upstream-compat/tsconfig.ours.json && node node_modules/typescript-7/bin/tsc -p test/dist/types/upstream-compat/tsconfig.upstream.json
scripts.test:built:differential: CANDIDATE=./dist/index.cjs CLASSIFY=ns-duplicate node dist-tests/test/fuzz.js xmldom08 80 41 all && CANDIDATE=./dist/index.cjs CLASSIFY=all node dist-tests/test/fuzz.js xmldom09 60 42 all && CANDIDATE=./dist/index.cjs node dist-tests/test/mutation.js && CANDIDATE=./dist/index.cjs CLASSIFY=ns-duplicate node dist-tests/test/fuzz-expr.js xmldom08 30 100 43 ns 5000 && CANDIDATE=./dist/index.cjs CLASSIFY=all node dist-tests/test/fuzz-expr.js xmldom09 30 100 44 ns 5000
scripts.test:built: npm run test:dist && npm run test:built:unit && npm run test:built:differential && npm run test:built:hostile
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:harness && npm run test:modes && npm run test:differential && npm run test:hostile
